sloka: ततोऽपरे द्युः तम् देशम् आजगाम स वीर्यवान् ।विभाण्डक सुतः श्रीमान् मनसा विचिन्तयन् मुहुः ॥१-१०-२४॥
transliteration: tato'pare dyuḥ tam deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān ।vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ śrīmān manasā vicintayan muhuḥ ॥1-10-24॥

translations.english: On the following day, the sage armed with the power of penance, came to the place where he had seen those enticing, welladorned courtesans.
